summary: Thomas has built her Oklahoma Senate campaign around a pro-Palestine platform, posting “Free Palestine” and pledging to call for an immediate ceasefire in Gaza and to restore USAID funding. Her anti-AIPAC messaging includes discarding a bin labeled “AIPAC Funds” and identifying as a sole grassroots candidate who rejects AIPAC and corporate PAC money. Vote for Peace rates her an Ally in the general phase.
